name: chevron-up-down
description: Opposing rounded chevrons for up and down in a square frame.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Original extension of the existing project Chevron family, using the supplied reference only for icon meaning, without third-party SVG paths. Chevron Up Down and Left Right combine two outward-facing heads. Up Down vertices are (8,10.5),(12,6.5),(16,10.5) and (16,13.5),(12,17.5),(8,13.5); the Filled heads have1.25px central separation, and Bold Outline retains.5px between endpoint caps. Chevron Line Up uses V vertices (8,15.5),(12,11.5),(16,15.5), with a separate bar from(8,8.5) to(16,8.5), giving1.25px Regular and.5px Bold head/bar clearance. Rotate the exact construction for other cardinal directions, without independent scaling. All source strokes are Regular1.75 with round caps/joins; Filled is the same triangle expanded by.875 plus a matching.875-radius bar capsule where present. None/Square/Circle reuse one glyph at identical position and size. Standard frame exteriors2..22, Square radius6, Circle radius10; Outline centerline radius5.125/9.125. Framed Filled subtracts the exact standalone solid-head-and-line silhouette as transparent negative space. Circle clearance remains positive at Bold2.50. All six new identities and frames are drafts; existing Single/Double Chevron geometry is unchanged. Current Square rounding trial: owner requested rounder enclosing frames. The exterior radius is now6 at unchanged bounds2..22; the matching Regular1.75 Outline centerline uses radius5.125 at bounds2.875..21.125. Only the outer enclosing contour changed. Inner glyph coordinates, cutout contours, object-specific rounding and positions remain exact. This rounding trial awaits owner visual review.

review.note: Owner approved every current static icon, style and supported frame on 2026-10-27. Motion approval is separate.

reviewHistory.note: Owner-requested rounder Square exterior radius6 trial; inner glyph preserved. Awaiting visual review.
